sections.description:
NATIONAL HIGHWAY AUTHORITY
NATIONAL HIGHWAY AUTHORITY
(APPOINTMENT AND PROMOTION)
RULES, 1995
(Insertion of proviso to R.6)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
25th November, 2011]
S.R.O.
1062(I)/2011, dated 1-10-2011.---In exercise of the Powers conferred under
section 31 read with section 14 of the National Highway Authority Act, 1991,
the following amendments are hereby made in the National Highway Authority
(Appointment and Promotion) Rules, 1995
with the approval
of the National
Highway Council (NHC);
2. Under
section 6 of the NHA (Appointment and Promotion) Rules, 1995, the following
proviso shall be inserted;
a.
Provided that the mode of appointment for the post of Member (BS-20/21) shall
be appointment by transfer/deputation for a tenure at the pleasure of the
Government. A Member may be appointed by the President, NHC from amongst
regularly promoted/ appointed General Managers and eligible deputationists on
the recommendations of Chairman, NHA and Secretary Communications. A member
shall have minimum qualifications of GM (Engr), GM (Finance) or Secretary/GM
(Coord), NHA as the case may be, prescribed in Schedule-IV to NHA (Appointment
and Promotion) Rules, 1995.
